arms.gain_08: Existing conditional negative-side lateral navigation gain 0.8, bounded +/-0.2 m/s
arms.gain_12: Same motor, causal condition and bound, lateral gain 1.2

procedure: Re-run each arm with an independent parent and late-swing actor under one new frozen runner source, 36 independent one-G1/ball physical episodes. The nine courses are consumed development cases; no fresh-generalization claim.
gate: At least three of six previous clean-but-off-target courses become high-quality, all three protection successes remain high-quality, total clean-foot contacts do not fall, zero new >4m out-of-play and zero pelvis <0.65m. Otherwise reject gain 1.2.
